annotation.bound_parties_text: The Commerce Control List identifies items (commodities, software, technology) subject to BIS export licensing authority under the EAR, thereby binding exporters, reexporters and transferors of those items.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: The Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) maintains the Commerce Control List (CCL) that includes “items”—i.e., “commodities,” “software,” and “technology”—subject to the authority of BIS.
annotation.dates_quote: Source: 61 FR 12937, Mar. 25, 1996, unless otherwise noted.
